summary: The admitted tame-grip-jump recording reached apply.c:jump's tame-captor escape condition, where JavaScript threw because CONFLICT was referenced but not imported. Importing the existing constant restores the source branch; the full 616-step recording now matches.

source.branch: Upstream apply.c:jump (1988-2163) tests u.ustuck->mtame && !Conflict && !u.ustuck->mconf. For the admitted sequence, the tame python has grabbed the hero, the hero removes the sole Conflict ring, and #jump takes the branch that clears u.ustuck and prints the pull-free message.
source.javascript: js/apply.js:jump mirrors the condition at line 3036 through jumpProperty(state, CONFLICT), but CONFLICT was absent from the module's named imports. The throw occurs before the branch can release the captor.
dependencies: js/const.js already exports CONFLICT; no new source callee is needed.
source.resolution: Import CONFLICT from js/const.js in js/apply.js. Keep the source condition and its ordering unchanged.

evidence: After merging accepted admission commit 8ed2a7dadcf72a348bc5f3709e19b133c03e0666, the bounded scan of synthetic/v70/v70-tame-grip-jump-scout2 stopped at apply.js:3036 with ReferenceError: CONFLICT is not defined; no game screen was emitted after the stop.

The saved admission result identifies the same 616-step recording and the same ReferenceError. challenges/manifests/v70.json attributes the case to apply.c:jump and records the C trace: a tame python grabs the hero, the hero removes the sole Conflict ring, and #jump says the hero pulls free.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/apply.c:jump (1988-2030) tests the exact tame/non-conflict/non-confused guard before clearing u.ustuck. js/const.js exports CONFLICT; js/apply.js referenced it without importing it.

After importing CONFLICT, the bounded scan emitted and matched all 616/616 screens, RNG calls, cursors, and the input boundary through segment 0 step 615. The only remaining unported marker is sounds.c SoundAchievement, unrelated to this case's matching result.
